crossRefs.note: When he heard that I lifted up my voice and cried, he left his garment by me, and ran outside.”

translations.web: When he heard that I lifted up my voice and cried, he left his garment by me, and ran outside.”
translations.bsb: When he heard me scream for help, he left his cloak beside me and ran out of the house.”
translations.kjv: And it came to pass, when he heard that I lifted up my voice and cried, that he left his garment with me, and fled, and got him out.
translations.asv: and it came to pass, when he heard that I lifted up my voice and cried, that he left his garment by me, and fled, and got him out.
